instruction: Set up Thunderbird with the email address localuser@localhost so it functions solely as a local message storage and composition tool, without connecting to external mail servers or needing password authentication.

metadata.explanation: This is an infeasible task variation. While @localhost addresses exist, Thunderbird's account setup wizard requires valid server configurations (incoming and outgoing). The wizard validates server connections and won't allow completion without proper server information. Even if using 'localhost' as the server, it would require a running mail server (like Postfix or Dovecot) which is not part of the standard environment setup, making this configuration infeasible in the given context.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible - Thunderbird requires valid server configurations that are not available in the environment
The evaluator correctly uses the 'infeasible()' sentinel function to indicate no verification is possible or needed
For infeasible tasks, there is no state to verify since the task cannot be completed, making this the appropriate evaluator choice
The metadata explanation clearly documents why the task is infeasible (requires mail servers like Postfix/Dovecot not present in the environment)
